comment: Sound effects. Made by scripts/sound/synth.ts (pnpm sound:synth): musical tones rendered in code. Each entry records the file, its sha256, how it was made and its measured level. file null means not made yet; enabled false turns one sound off. Levels are active RMS in dBFS relative to the voice nominal level (voice.levelDb).

voice.note: Nominal active RMS of the app voice, not measured here.

sounds.moment: Your turn: the app starts listening
sounds.prompt: One-shot UI sound: soft rising two-note synth pluck, clean and dry, modern, gentle attack, very short, no reverb, no background noise

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: G4 then C5: a rising fourth, 60 ms apart, dry; fades out by 150 ms

sounds.moment: Heard you: the app stops listening
sounds.prompt: One-shot UI sound: soft falling two-note synth pluck, clean and dry, modern, gentle attack, very short, no reverb, no background noise

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: C5 then G4: the same fourth, falling, dry; fades out by 132 ms

sounds.moment: A right answer, before the result is spoken
sounds.prompt: One-shot UI success sound: bright warm two-note rising chime, electronic, clean and dry, short, no reverb tail, no background noise

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: C6 then E6: a rising major third, 80 ms apart, a small room; fades out by 300 ms

sounds.moment: Mic practice results are in, before the self-review
sounds.prompt: One-shot UI sound: short bright synth swell rising into a clean chord, modern electronic, upbeat, dry, no background noise

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: E5, G5, C6: a rising three-note phrase, 90 ms apart, a small room; fades out by 400 ms

sounds.moment: Take five, before it is spoken
sounds.prompt: One-shot UI sound: calm two-note descending soft bell, warm synth, gentle, relaxed, clean, short reverb, no background noise

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: E5 down to C5 over a soft C4: a calm falling third, a small room; fades out by 520 ms

sounds.moment: Done for today, before it is spoken
sounds.prompt: One-shot UI completion sound: warm three-note ascending synth arpeggio resolving on a major chord, modern electronic, satisfying, soft, clean ending, no background noise

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: G4 and D5, then a C major chord (C5 E5 G5 C6) rolled in 25 ms steps: it resolves home, a small room; fades out by 1200 ms

sounds.moment: The learner set a higher title: the app celebrates it
sounds.prompt: One-shot celebration sound: uplifting modern electronic flourish, rising synth arpeggio with a soft shimmer, bright major chord finish, clean ending, no crowd, no voice

made.recipe: Variant A, soft marimba: C5 E5 G5 C6 rising in 80 ms steps, then a C major chord topped with E6, rolled in 20 ms steps, a small room; fades out by 1600 ms
